messages:
Sarah (AE): Hi team — ArborBank is ready to start a 6-week POC next Monday. Requirements: SAML SSO (Okta), SCIM provisioning ~25k users, RBAC role sync, multi-subdomain domain verification, and a security questionnaire. Need POC plan, temporary pricing (Dedicated vs Hosted) and answers for the SQ by EOW.
Miguel (SE): Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Will they do a one-time initial SCIM import or incremental SCIM only? 2) Do they need group->role mapping (product roles vs org roles)? 3) Any hard SLA expectations during the POC?
Alex (Customer): We'll use Okta SCIM connector, incremental sync only. Yes, group->role mapping is required (they map Okta groups to our product roles). POC SLA: 99% during business hours is ideal, but this is a trial so flexible.
Priya (Security): Can you confirm SOC 2 report availability, encryption-at-rest with customer KMS option (for Private), audit log access, and data residency for EU tenants? Also send over the security questionnaire link.
Sarah (AE): @Priya I'll attach the questionnaire to the prospect in 2h. @Miguel they specifically want incremental SCIM + group->role mapping.
Miguel (SE): For group->role mapping we support rule-based sync. Example mapping we can include in the runbook:
```
scim.groupName -> rbac.role
"arbor_admins" -> "org_admin"
"arbor_readers" -> "viewer"
```
Initial sync notes: for ~25k users recommend Dedicated POC so we can temporarily increase SCIM rate limits. Full initial backfill (if needed) can be batched; estimate full backfill 30–45 minutes under Dedicated with batch size tuning.
Tom (Sales Eng Manager): +1 on Dedicated for the POC. For pricing let's propose a short-term commit for 2x GPUs + elevated network/IO for provisioning. Rough draft estimate for the 6-week POC (provisioning + dedicated uplift): ~ $5k - $8k total. I'll firm numbers with finance.
Erin (Legal): Need to confirm DPA and data processing clauses for EU residency. Also confirm whether SCIM payloads will include any sensitive fields or PHI — if PHI, we need HIPAA addendum.
Miguel (SE): SAML options: we support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; we accept IdP metadata upload. For domain ownership we support DNS TXT verification and email verification. For multi-subdomain automation we recommend DNS TXT. Example TXT record: `redwood-verification=arborbank-2026`.
Sarah (AE): Action items: 1) Miguel — prepare POC runbook with SCIM delta examples, sample logs, and a SCIM rate-lift request; 2) Priya & Erin — complete security questionnaire + confirm DPA/HIPAA path; 3) Tom — draft provisional POC pricing and short-term commit. Target: EOD Friday.
Alex (Customer): Also need SCIM event log retention policy — can we get 90 days? We use logs for audit and deprovisioning trace.
Priya (Security): Default retention is 30 days. We can extend to 90 days on Dedicated or Private with an add-on. I'll confirm implications and SLA.
Miguel (SE): Noted. I'll include sample SCIM event lines and retention options in the runbook. Example delta request/response snippets will be added.
Sarah (AE): Great — I'll update the opportunity, send the kickoff calendar invite when runbook is ready, and loop in the customer success engineer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
